_meta.description: Sponsored Display negative targets. Daily snapshot — every fire upserts the full current set. Sourced via Ads-API v3 paginated POST /sd/negativeTargets/list. SD has only target-level negatives (no separate keyword negatives or campaign-level endpoint as of API v3).
_meta.retention_note: Never pruned: the table holds the current state, one row per negative of each advertising profile. A negative Amazon no longer lists is removed at the next sync that lists any. `snapshot_date` is the day the row was last written, so every row is current; freshness is the sync state, not this date.

columns.note: Ads profile id (one per marketplace) — auto-filtered from the store suffix; do not filter manually.
Marketplace this ads row belongs to. Query ads data per (store, country_code) directly — no need to reverse-map profile_id.

columns.comment: Marketplace-local date the snapshot was captured.
Server-side timestamp the row was UPSERTed.
columns.note: UTC instant (timestamptz). Query results show it in the store ref's marketplace local time, without an offset; a bare date in a filter is that marketplace's midnight.

columns.comment: Campaign id this negative scopes to.
Ad group id this negative scopes to.
JSON-stringified array of Amazon's targeting clauses (asinSameAs / asinCategorySameAs / asinBrandSameAs).
Any Amazon response fields not promoted to a typed column.
columns.note: Documented opt-out (2026-07-11): resolvedExpression — duplicate of the targeting expression in resolved form, ~10 rows, deliberately not promoted.
Internal change-detection digest of the row (binary). Not for analysis; never filter on it.
